title: Review of Allowances for Full-time National Servicemen Given Inflationary Pressures
what_it_is: Review of Allowances for Full-time National Servicemen Given Inflationary Pressures

sections.label: NSF allowance adjustments and reviews
sections.summary: The allowance accounts for lodging, food, clothing and medical care provided by the Singapore Armed Forces and Home Team, with three adjustments in 10 years, the latest in March 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The allowance takes into account that lodging, food, clothing and medical care are provided for by the Singapore Armed Forces and the Home Team given that most NSFs stay in camp.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Three adjustments have been made over the last 10 years, the most recent being in March 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: MINDEF will continue to conduct such regular reviews and where necessary, adjust the allowances.

sections.label: NSF allowance review considerations
sections.summary: Reviews monitor overall price levels, but general cost of living does not apply to NSF upkeep, which the Singapore Armed Forces and Home Team pay for.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my reply, when we provide a calibration of the allowance for our NSFs, we certainly will have to monitor the overall price levels within the country.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: But at the same time, it is also very pertinent for us to know and remember that it is not the general cost of living that actually applies to the upkeep of NSFs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: And these are already taken care of and paid for by the Singapore Armed Forces, as well as the Home Team for NSFs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: So, we will take everything into account in the review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: And again, as I have mentioned, if you look back over the last 10 years, we have conducted no fewer than three reviews and we will certainly take all these into account going forward as well.
